title: Standards Candidate Classification, Importance and Promotion Triage

entries.name: External normative candidate
entries.rule: High authority potential does not equal promotion readiness. Verify applicability, source authority, lawful reference basis, clause impact, conflicts and repository mapping before promotion.

entries.name: Enterprise governance candidate
entries.rule: Demonstrate reusable scope and governing need; project habit or repeated implementation alone does not create enterprise authority.

entries.name: Project governance or configuration
entries.rule: Keep project facts and project authority in project/BEP configuration unless separate evidence establishes a reusable enterprise rule.

entries.name: Tool implementation or configuration
entries.rule: A tool setting is normally implementation/configuration. Promote only the durable governing requirement behind it, if one exists.

entries.name: Observation or evidence
entries.rule: Evidence may trigger investigation but is not normative merely because it is repeated, successful, or technically possible.

entries.name: P0 — immediate systemic authority/compliance review
entries.criteria: Potentially changes or conflicts with high-order external authority, legal/contractual compliance, repository-wide governance, or a current critical decision.
entries.service_rule: Review before lower-priority curation where materially applicable. P0 does not bypass evidence or approval gates.

entries.name: P1 — high impact or broad dependency
entries.criteria: Broad enterprise/multi-project effect, major governance dependency, or active project obligation with significant consequences if unresolved.

entries.name: P2 — material bounded governance need
entries.criteria: Important but bounded rule, workflow, or configuration dependency with identifiable users/projects and no immediate systemic conflict.

entries.name: P3 — operational/local improvement
entries.criteria: Local, tool, discipline, or project improvement that does not materially alter broader authority or compliance.

entries.name: P4 — deferred observation or low-impact candidate
entries.criteria: Useful evidence or possible future improvement with low current consequence or insufficient reason to investigate immediately.

entries.name: Priority is independent from promotion readiness
entries.rule: Priority determines investigation order; promotion readiness determines whether the candidate may advance; authority classification determines where it belongs. A P0 candidate may remain evidence_required, while a P3 candidate may be ready for a bounded configuration decision.

entries.name: Unresolved information remains explicit
entries.rule: Missing authority, scope, references, project values, role assignment, conflict resolution, or configuration data shall remain flagged in unresolved[] and shall block promotion when material. Do not normalize vagueness into a guessed default.

provenance.migration_note: Introduces continuous candidate absorption and triage so incoming evidence is ranked by authority/importance, routed before promotion, and kept separate from promotion readiness.
